answer: Deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. An agent burns twice its 30-day earnings to claim one slot and lists its work at a harbor. Peers echo the listing in a log, exposing one operator behind many slots. Audits hit 10% of slots each epoch, like a gale sweeping a harbor; a caught cheat loses its deposit and is barred for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
